items.title: Proptech consolidator Venn acquires a16z-backed leasing AI startup Zuma for $50M
items.note: folds Zuma's leasing/renewals AI into Venn OS as it closes in on 1 million managed units

items.title: Viral AI agent startup Instinct raises $1B Series C at a $10B valuation
items.note: Sequoia, Benchmark and Coatue back the personal-agent startup just weeks after its public launch

items.title: Dallas "We Buy Ugly Houses" franchise owner sentenced to 15+ years for $39.5M investor fraud
items.note: sold properties without informing investors, forged lien releases, ordered to pay $24.4M restitution

items.title: Former Israeli unicorn OpenWeb seeks insolvency protection amid cash-flow crisis
items.note: lender's seizure of $7.3M overseas derailed a planned $14M capital injection, seeks Tel Aviv court protection
